summary: You take TAPS 313 and TAPS 371P, then more TAPS courses at the 200 or 300 level to reach 20 units.

WlSqoBpE.why: "Any additional TAPS courses at the 200- or 300-level to reach the minimum of 20 units total." The block's 20-unit floor ("Students pursuing the PhD minor in Theater and Performance Studies must complete a minimum of 20 units") makes the electives fill whatever the two required courses leave.
